description: Birth, as a pseudo-date: 1 July of the first admission year minus cases.AgeOnAdmission (SICdb rounds age to +-5 years and sets ages over 90 to 90)
source: SICdb docs Case_Data https://www.sicdb.com/wiki/index.php?title=Case_Data&oldid=288 (AgeOnAdmission; CC BY 4.0); pre_MEDS.get_patient_link

description: Death within one year after admission (cases.OffsetOfDeath; SICdb records 1-year mortality only, so later deaths are absent)
source: SICdb docs Case_Data https://www.sicdb.com/wiki/index.php?title=Case_Data&oldid=288 (OffsetOfDeath; CC BY 4.0); pre_MEDS.get_patient_link

description: Admission of an SICdb case, i.e. an ICU admission; the first case is placed at 1 July of its AdmissionYear, later cases at cases.OffsetAfterFirstAdmission
source: SICdb docs Case_Description https://www.sicdb.com/wiki/index.php?title=Case_Description&oldid=378 and Case_Data https://www.sicdb.com/wiki/index.php?title=Case_Data&oldid=288 (AdmissionYear; OffsetAfterFirstAdmission; CC BY 4.0); pre_MEDS.get_patient_link

description: Hospital discharge after the patient's first case, placed at midday of cases.HospitalDischargeDay (SICdb records the day only); not emitted when a death is recorded
source: SICdb docs Case_Data https://www.sicdb.com/wiki/index.php?title=Case_Data&oldid=288 (HospitalDischargeDay; CC BY 4.0); pre_MEDS.get_patient_link

description: Body weight on admission, in grams as stored (cases.WeightOnAdmission; SICdb rounds it to +-5 kg)
source: SICdb docs Case_Data https://www.sicdb.com/wiki/index.php?title=Case_Data&oldid=288 (WeightOnAdmission; CC BY 4.0); unit from the value range of SICdb 1.0.8 (every non-zero value exceeds 1000)

description: Body height on admission, cm (cases.HeightOnAdmission; SICdb rounds it to +-5 cm)
Start of heart surgery, at the incision (cases.HeartSurgeryBeginOffset)
No ICD-10 main diagnosis recorded for the case (cases.ICD10Main is empty; UNK is the MEDS-Transforms fill value for a missing code component)
